$comment: Where CaTH (and the pip it is compared with) runs in each environment a check can target. local is a developer's machine; test is CaTH perftest paired with pip test, which is how CaTH's own chart pairs them (apps/web/helm/values.yaml). Secret names are looked up in the app's keyVault, or taken from an environment variable of the same name in upper snake case (CATH_SERVICE_API_CLIENT_ID for cath-service-api-client-id), which wins.

cath.$signIn: session: writes each fixture user's session into local Redis (cath/sign-in.ts). Needs SESSION_SECRET and REDIS_URL from the root .env.
accounts: signs in through the real sign-in flows as the test account for each role. A role with no account in the vault is reported as not compared.
cath.$filesWaitSeconds: The publication API makes a list's files after accepting it, so they are waited for
